mostWorthwhile.text: Adding the venous valves was most worthwhile: the planned paired valve positions and contracting muscle show how blood is driven toward the heart while backflow is resisted.

leastWorthwhile.text: Making the thin-walled veins was the least engaging passage on its own; the more informative valve and muscle relationship came in the following construction.

surprise.text: The venous return picture added contracting limb muscle to the explanation, making return flow more than just a matter of valve placement.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, though 'arterioles' and 'lumen' appeared without explanation; the branching picture gives some context for arterioles, but the terms may need clarification for the intended audience.

continue.text: I would be mildly interested in continuing to see how the vessel route connects with the larger circulation. The constructions were clear, although the final choices were largely sequential.
